elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to six (6) months

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other data of the Company

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems
and certify such deletion to the Company in writing
up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates (exceeds 90 days)
within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to the Company all ... data ... in a standard machine-readable format

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present in operative text: up-to-six-month transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Company data in standard machine-readable format measured from expiry/termination (not a later request), followed by deletion and written certification.

The 'at the Company's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance, which is appropriate; the mandatory data return, deletion and certification duties are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the exit mechanics.

Insertion of a single new Section 4.3 is the minimal fix where the Agreement contained no exit mechanics at all; Sections 4.1 and 4.2 (term, renewal, notice, Termination Payment schedule) are untouched and remain effective.
No undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced; 'Content', 'HDI' and 'Company' are existing defined/named terms, and the deletion duty is properly sequenced after return.
